## TRACE 2.5.0

One list of everything a case holds, place names for GPS positions,
exports that say what they lack, a far more complete Project VICS
export, and the newest LEAPP releases.

### New

- **Artifacts navigator and Case Overview.** An "Artifacts" tab beside
  the Tree View lists every kind of artifact in the case with its count,
  for one image or all: no need to know which Triage sub-tab or Activity
  category holds it. Scans that have not run, or stopped part-way, are
  greyed with a Run command. The **Overview** panel, in front when a
  case opens, shows the evidence, a tile per section, what is worth a
  look and which scans have not finished (Run Missing Scans).
- **Place names for GPS positions, offline.** Photos, videos, the Map,
  Activity's locations, File Metadata and the report now say where a
  position is -- "4 km NE of Reading, Wokingham, United Kingdom" --
  worked out from Natural Earth data shipped with TRACE. Nothing is
  sent online. Shown as "Near (approx.)": borders are accurate to about
  200 m, and only towns and cities are named.
- **Exports say which scans have not run.** Project VICS, DFXML,
  CASE/UCO, the Timeline's export and Create Report each check the scans
  they draw on (for VICS: carving of every picture and video type) and
  say what is missing, with **Run Missing Scans, Then Export**.

### Project VICS export

Compared with AXIOM, X-Ways, FEX and Griffeye on the M57 'Jean' image,
the export now also includes:

- pictures and videos inside archives, mailboxes and documents, listed
  under their container's path (a container's category is never given
  to its members)
- pictures kept by Word, Excel and PowerPoint 97-2003
- browser caches: Firefox (cache v1 and cache2), Chromium (blockfile
  and simple cache), Safari's Cache.db
- pictures and videos stored as BLOBs in SQLite databases
- Volume Shadow Copies, when asked (a snapshot's unchanged copy of a
  live file is left out)
- WMF, EMF, Flash and TGA, recognised the same way on every system
- optionally, pictures carved from inside any file

Without carving, coverage of AXIOM's media on M57 went from 35% to 65%,
of X-Ways' from 41% to 79%.

### Carving

- **Pictures that start inside a sector** (case setting, off by
  default): JPEG, PNG, GIF and BMP are searched for at every byte of
  free space and slack, each marked as found inside a sector.
- **Sources are kept together**: carving unallocated space, slack or
  memory files no longer replaces the carves of the others.
- **hiberfil.sys** of Windows XP to 7 is decompressed and carved.

### External modules (LEAPPs)

- **The newest release is offered**, not the one TRACE was tested with,
  and **installed tools are said to be out of date** (Modules tab,
  Supported Features). Installing an update is still your click.
- aLEAPP 2026.4.4 and iLEAPP 2026.4.5 renamed columns TRACE reads:
  runs of either release now keep their times, directions and parties.
  Cases sort their runs again when opened.
- DLEAPP on a Mac: Apple System Log lines are no longer read as chats,
  and rows of files a Mac shows under several paths preview again.

### Fixed

- Closing TRACE while carving was being cancelled logged errors from a
  count reading a case already closed.

### Cases

Cases are upgraded to schema 26 when opened (how each scan ended is
recorded). TRACE 2.4.x cannot open a case that 2.5.0 has opened.
